boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the Wabash Avenue/National Road corridor between Rose-Hulman and downtown Terre Haute.

cards.title: Curtis Gilbert Park: shaded outdoor pause
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 1431 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Use the sidewalks and shaded grounds for a daytime reset; the city plan identifies a playground, shelters, plaza, and limestone sculpture.
cards.short_summary: An urban park with several documented outdoor features.
cards.evidence_claim: The city’s park plan places Curtis Gilbert Park at 1431 Wabash Avenue and documents its playground, shelters, sidewalks, plaza, and limestone sculpture.
cards.source_title: Terre Haute Park and Recreation Master Plan
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city park; check local conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Crossroads of America Plaza: road-history marker
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 643 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Stop for the Crossroads sign, historic marker, Wabash Valley Musicians Mural, and brick piano before continuing along downtown Wabash.
cards.short_summary: A public plaza interpreting Terre Haute’s transportation crossroads.
cards.evidence_claim: The city tourism walking tour locates Crossroads of America Plaza at 643 Wabash Avenue and identifies its sign, historic marker, mural, and brick piano.
cards.source_title: Historic Downtown Terre Haute West District Walking Tour
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-space stop; use normal street-crossing care.

cards.title: Swope Art Museum: American art
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 25 South 7th Street, just off Wabash
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit for works from the museum’s American-art collection; confirm reopening status and hours directly before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown museum with nearly 2,500 American artworks.
cards.evidence_claim: Swope identifies its address as 25 South 7th Street, just south of Wabash Avenue, and describes a permanent collection of nearly 2,500 American works.
cards.access_notes: The museum website lists Tuesday–Sunday noon–5 p.m.; confirm access because its visit page notes renovation information.

cards.title: Indiana Theatre: Spanish Revival façade
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — on Ohio Street beside the Wabash/7th Street area
cards.notes: Walk one block south of Wabash to view the elaborate terra-cotta exterior and atmospheric-theater design noted on the official walking tour.
cards.short_summary: A 1922 theater landmark near the central Wabash corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The city tourism walking tour states that Indiana Theatre opened in 1922 and is known for its Spanish Revival design, terra-cotta façade, and atmospheric theater design.
cards.source_title: Historic Downtown Terre Haute West District Walking Tour
cards.access_notes: Viewable from the public street; event and interior access vary.

cards.title: Terre Haute Children’s Museum: hands-on exhibits
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 727 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Check the current exhibit list before visiting; the museum describes three floors of science-and-learning exhibits, including Water Works and a ropes course.
cards.short_summary: A three-floor interactive museum on downtown Wabash.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists 727 Wabash Avenue and describes three floors of science, learning, and interactive exhibits including Water Works and a ropes challenge course.
cards.access_notes: Current entry hours are posted by the museum; admission is ticketed.

cards.title: Larry Bird Museum: basketball memorabilia
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 800 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Visit during posted hours for the self-guided exhibits of jerseys, memorabilia, interviews, and basketball history; group tours need advance scheduling.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided museum dedicated to Larry Bird’s career.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists 800 Wabash Avenue, complimentary admission, self-guided tours, and exhibits including memorabilia, jerseys, and interviews.
cards.source_title: Larry Bird Museum — Plan a Visit
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Wednesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Monday and Tuesday.

cards.title: Terre Haute Convention Center: scheduled public events
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 800 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Check its event calendar before making the trip; this downtown venue hosts conferences, trade shows, community events, and other programmed gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A large downtown events facility sharing the Wabash corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The convention center lists 800 Wabash Avenue and says its flexible event spaces host conferences, trade shows, weddings, fundraisers, and community events.
cards.access_notes: Entry and cost depend on the specific event; consult the venue’s current event information.

cards.title: Clabber Girl Museum: baking-company history
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 900 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Explore the baking and Hulman-family history displays, then verify current museum operations directly before traveling to the downtown address.
cards.short_summary: A museum interpreting Clabber Girl and Hulman history.
cards.evidence_claim: Indiana’s official tourism site identifies the Clabber Girl Museum at 900 Wabash Avenue and describes exhibits on the Hulman family, Terre Haute, and baking powder.
cards.source_title: Visit Indiana — Terre Haute Has a Baking Museum
cards.access_notes: Verify current hours and museum availability directly before visiting.

cards.title: Vigo County History Center: local history
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 929 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Set aside time for the three floors of exhibits and artifacts, and check the museum’s current exhibitions or programs before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: A three-floor county-history museum on Wabash Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The History Center lists 929 Wabash Avenue and describes three floors and 34,000 square feet of exhibits connecting visitors with Vigo County history.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; admission is listed by the museum.

cards.entity_name: Veterans Memorial Museum of Terre Haute
cards.title: Veterans Memorial Museum: service artifacts
cards.subtitle: Wabash Avenue corridor — 1129 Wabash Avenue
cards.notes: Plan for the Saturday open window and browse the locally collected military artifacts spanning World War I through Afghanistan.
cards.short_summary: A commemorative museum with military artifacts from multiple eras.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists 1129 Wabash Avenue, Saturday noon–4 p.m. hours, and military memorabilia from World War I, World War II, Korea, Vietnam, the Persian Gulf, Iraq, and Afghanistan.
cards.source_title: Veterans Memorial Museum of Terre Haute — About
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Saturday noon–4 p.m.; contact the museum to confirm access before visiting.
